title: Projection schemes and the fixed point property in nonreflexive Banach spaces
summary: We introduce the notion of a projection scheme on a Banach space and develop an abstract framework for studying the fixed point property (FPP) for nonexpansive mappings. Within this framework, we obtain a general criterion ensuring the FPP for a broad class of nonreflexive Banach spaces. In particular, every uniformly convex Banach space admits an isometric embedding into a nonreflexive Banach space having the FPP.
